whole_lifecycle_findings.finding: Datagen wrapper stores inner FinishedRecipe and shared tag reference, embeds inner complete recipe+SNBT, retains inner recipe/advancement IDs and JSON, changes outer serializer type only. with creates a tag once per consumer, not one immutable copy per emitted recipe; no concurrent mutation safety claim.

Load parses nested recipe with same ID via deprecated two-arg fromJson, then replaces live result tag and returns INNER recipe. Outer reload checks conditions/context first; wrapper default three-arg serializer discards context and nested parser uses EMPTY. No guarantee nested conditional custom recipes retain outer context or avoid null. Missing tag/invalid SNBT reject; null/EMPTY/computed-result edge paths are not certified.

Shown shapeless result is a live template usable with RegistryAccess.EMPTY. setTag assigns supplied compound (then damage/tag verification), not merge. Later assemble copies this template; consumes no input inside assemble and preserves no arbitrary input name/enchant/damage/variant/caps. Different dynamic/copy-return/registry-dependent inner getters need separate review.

Template copy preserves its ordinary tag and serialized capabilities. Botania setTag alone does NOT extract ForgeCaps into capability initialization; native Forge JSON helper separately extracts ForgeCaps and reconstructs with ItemStack.of. An ordinary tag key called ForgeCaps is not equivalent to actual saved capability payload. No universal capsule/full-state recovery promise.

One base tiara recipe plus eight quartz recipe IDs select fixed variants1..8 from SAME tiara item. Standard item ingredient serialized item-only and test ignores stack NBT; no original variant/crafter requirement and no original state merge. Eight parameters are one wrapper mechanism, not eight unrelated implementations.

getVariant reads integer key default0; creative catalog writes variants0..8. This is actual variant reader/catalog, not paid acquisition proof, nor evidence of different flight powers or full rendering/flight implementation acceptance.

Head example uses SkullOwner plus16pink ingredients and a reagent path. Petals getter live/assemble copy and its own network serializer can transport template. matches stops at first empty slot and does not test later occupied slots or reagent inside that method; complete BE debit/reagent/entity receipt path was not read, so this is wrapper supporting context0, not second paid implementation.

Returned INNER serializer gets sent with same recipe ID and actual result, so wrapper network methods intentionally throwing do not prove shown recipes cannot sync. No wrapper recipe object persists for packet selection. Network runtime/overrides remain untested.

writeItem defaults limitedTag=true, writes share-tag only conditional on item damageability/override. Default item overrides=true and IForgeItem share/read use ordinary stack tag/setTag. Custom share behavior may omit state; default path is not all-caps serialization or authenticated client/result acceptance.

This pinned Forge already supports result NBT object or SNBT in ordinary shaped/shapeless JSON, separately reconstructing caps. Botania wrapper may serve cross-platform/template adaptation, not proof Dynasty must add a redundant serializer. Version applicability is fixed Forge47.4.10 source artifact, not arbitrary versions.

Template load/datagen/unlock is not native paid acquisition. Callbacks/criterion precede debit; ingredient-list shallow copy, no output stack in criterion. Preserve intended native result route and explicit variant data rather than base ItemTask/icon/generic first_infusion or duplicate reward.

mandatory_constraints: Exact cached repo metadata/recursive tree/raw Git blobs only; no raw commit/treeobject provenance chain or fresh remote verification.
19 generated raw bodies absent in the two explicitly checked cache roots: 9recipe+9advancement tiara bodies and1head recipe; tree identity alone is not resource-body reading/loading.
Live constant getter usable with RegistryAccess.EMPTY is required; CustomRecipe.EMPTY, copy-return, computed/registry-dependent or null inner recipes not certified.
setTag REPLACES template ordinary data, does not merge consumed input state or initialize tag-embedded ForgeCaps.
Wrapper returns inner recipe same ID; packet uses inner serializer and cannot be diagnosed from throwing wrapper networking alone.
Outer conditions are checked by reload; nested deprecated parser resets context to EMPTY, no blanket custom condition compatibility.
Standard shown tiara ingredient is item-only; eight variant recipes and creative entries count one mechanism and do not prove player ownership or retained old state.
Share-tag packet path does not unconditionally carry every capability; no runtime network/MP/native crafting acceptance.
Petal example is supporting template context0; no independent complete BE payment/reagent/thrower chain read or credited.
Original author Tinkers49-line comparison remains unbound0; this reviewer did not claim to read it or accept a second implementation.
Reuse exact prior own registration/helper/native craft and three whole structured decision evidence without new reading/credit inflation.
Original Dynasty IDs/rewards/progress preserved, material->prerequisite->paid native craft->intended NBT output acquisition; no broad base-item substitution or repeated branch rewards.
No production/game/build/QA or prompt deletion; applicable NBT semantic1000 gate still unmet and formal ecology remains23.
application_to_Dynasty: Four NBT variant quest branches must resolve output NBT and the actual crafting/table result path; preserve current IDs, old rewards and native costs.

Existing Forge JSON output support is a possible minimal route for a static output; do not introduce this Botania wrapper or copy upstream code/assets without need. No production recipe change authorized by this incomplete1000 gate.

Distinguish fixed template replacement from prior composite/split preserving selected input state; they are not automatically two unique global credits. Independent reviewer must compare complete prior owner decisions, not only labels.
